We are seeking an experienced Platform Operations Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize enterprise technology platforms, ensuring their availability, scalability, security, and performance. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in platform administration, cloud infrastructure, automation, monitoring, and operational support, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and ensure reliable platform operations.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in platform operations, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or cloud operations.
Strong knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience managing containerization technologies, particularly Docker and Kubernetes.
Good understanding of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
Strong understanding of networking, security, load balancing, and distributed systems.
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or Splunk.
Knowledge of ITIL practices, incident management, and problem management.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Relevant certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, CKA, or CKAD.
Experience with microservices architecture and cloud-native technologies.
Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
Knowledge of high-availability architectures and disaster recovery strategies.
Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.
Understanding of security best practices and compliance standards.
